items.quote: Senden Sie uns das ausgefüllte Formular bitte binnen 13 Werktagen nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens zurück (Werktage: Montag bis Samstag ohne gesetzliche Feiertage).
items.computation: Letter is dated 21.11.2026 (Saturday). Period runs 'nach dem Datum dieses Schreibens' (after the date), so per §187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of the triggering event (21.11.2026) is not counted; counting of Werktage starts 22.11.2026. The letter itself defines Werktage as Monday-Saturday excluding statutory public holidays, so Sundays are skipped entirely and do not count as a Werktag. Enumerating Werktage from 22.11.2026: 23.11 (Mon,1), 24.11 (Tue,2), 25.11 (Wed,3), 26.11 (Thu,4), 27.11 (Fri,5), 28.11 (Sat,6), 30.11 (Mon,7), 01.12 (Tue,8), 02.12 (Wed,9), 03.12 (Thu,10), 04.12 (Fri,11), 05.12 (Sat,12), 07.12 (Mon,13). No public holidays in NRW fall within this window (01.11 Allerheiligen already past, next holiday is 25.12). Werktag 13 lands on Monday 07.12.2026, which is itself a Werktag, so no further shift is needed.

warnings: This is a private insurer's internal claims deadline, not a statutory authority deadline, so the §187/188 BGB counting and the Werktage definition supplied in the letter were applied directly rather than any administrative delivery-fiction rule; the exact due date (2026-12-07) therefore carries medium rather than high confidence.
